attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
"To develop a user-friendly KYC (Know Your Customer) application, let's identify the key EPICS and FEATURES and generate related USER STORIES.

---

## EPICS and FEATURES

### Epic 1: User Registration and Onboarding
- **Feature 1.1:** User Account Creation
- **Feature 1.2:** Identity Verification
- **Feature 1.3:** Profile Completion

### Epic 2: Document Management
- **Feature 2.1:** Document Upload
- **Feature 2.2:** Document Verification
- **Feature 2.3:** Document Storage

### Epic 3: User Interface and Experience
- **Feature 3.1:** Intuitive Navigation
- **Feature 3.2:** Responsive Design
- **Feature 3.3:** Multilingual Support

## USER STORIES

### Epic 1: User Registration and Onboarding

#### Feature 1.1: User Account Creation
- **User Story 1:**
  As a **NEW USER**, I want to **CREATE AN ACCOUNT** so that I can **ACCESS THE APPLICATION**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - The user must be able to register with an email and password.
    - A verification email is sent to the user upon registration.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - The account creation process is complete when the user verifies the email.

#### Feature 1.2: Identity Verification
- **User Story 2:**
  As a **USER**, I want to **VERIFY MY IDENTITY** so that I can **COMPLY WITH REGULATIONS**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - The system accepts government-issued IDs for verification.
    - The status of the verification is provided in real-time.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - The user's identity is verified and a confirmation is sent.

#### Feature 1.3: Profile Completion
- **User Story 3:**
  As a **USER**, I want to **COMPLETE MY PROFILE** so that I can **ENHANCE MY SECURITY AND ACCESS FULL FEATURES**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - Users should be prompted to complete personal details.
    - A progress bar indicates the completion status.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - All mandatory fields are filled and saved.

### Epic 2: Document Management

#### Feature 2.1: Document Upload
- **User Story 4:**
  As a **USER**, I want to **UPLOAD DOCUMENTS** so that I can **COMPLETE THE KYC PROCESS**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - Users can upload documents in PDF, JPG, or PNG formats.
    - An upload confirmation message is displayed.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - Documents are successfully uploaded and acknowledged.

#### Feature 2.2: Document Verification
- **User Story 5:**
  As a **KYC ADMIN**, I want to **VERIFY UPLOADED DOCUMENTS** so that I can **APPROVE OR REJECT USERS**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - Document verification must be completed within 24 hours.
    - Notifications are sent upon approval or rejection.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - Documents are reviewed and a decision is communicated to the user.

#### Feature 2.3: Document Storage
- **User Story 6:**
  As a **SYSTEM ADMIN**, I want to **STORE USER DOCUMENTS SECURELY** so that I can **PROTECT USER DATA**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - Documents are encrypted while in storage.
    - Access logs are maintained for document retrieval.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - Documents are securely stored and accessible only to authorized personnel.

### Epic 3: User Interface and Experience

#### Feature 3.1: Intuitive Navigation
- **User Story 7:**
  As a **USER**, I want **EASY NAVIGATION** so that I can **USE THE APPLICATION WITHOUT ANY CONFUSION**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - Navigation menus are clearly labelled.
    - Users can easily find help or support sections.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - User testing confirms ease of navigation.

#### Feature 3.2: Responsive Design
- **User Story 8:**
  As a **USER**, I want the **APPLICATION TO BE RESPONSIVE** so that I can **ACCESS IT ON ANY DEVICE**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - The application adapts to different screen sizes and orientations.
    - Performance remains optimal on mobile devices.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - The application passes responsiveness testing across devices.

#### Feature 3.3: Multilingual Support
- **User Story 9:**
  As a **USER**, I want **MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT** so that I can **USE THE APPLICATION IN MY PREFERRED LANGUAGE**.
  - **Acceptance Criteria:**
    - The application supports major languages like English, Spanish, and Chinese.
    - Language preferences are easily set in user profiles.
  - **Definition of Done:**
    - Users can switch languages and the application displays all elements correctly.
